sources.snippet: ABot-OCR is an end-to-end vision-language model that transcribes a document page image directly into clean Markdown in a single forward pass—no brittle modular orchestration. It recognizes and preserves text, mathematical formulas (LaTeX), tables (HTML), and related layout elements.

sources.snippet: We introduce ABot-OCR, an end-to-end vision-language model that transcribes a page image directly into clean Markdown in a single forward pass. By doing so, our approach completely eliminates the need for brittle modular orchestration.
